jobs.occupation: GraphDB Specialist / Data Engineer  Neo4j & Knowledge Graph (Göteborg)
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced GraphDB Specialist (Data Engineer) to design, develop and maintain a central Knowledge Graph data foundation for a Cybersecurity Data Collection and Correlation (CDC) Engine.
In this role, you will work with complex data structures, security-related entities and relationships, building scalable graph database solutions. You will also contribute to integrating graph data with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines using GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying.
You will collaborate with technical teams to develop reliable data architecture, automate ingestion workflows and ensure secure and efficient access to graph data.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop Knowledge Graph architecture, ontology and data models.

Build and maintain graph data ingestion pipelines.

Implement GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying to integrate graph data with LLM-based applications.

Develop and manage graph database solutions using Neo4j and Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin).

Integrate data ingestion and graph update workflows into CI/CD pipelines.

Manage graph database configurations, updates and data relationships.

Ensure data quality, consistency, scalability and secure access to graph information.

Collaborate with engineering, AI and cybersecurity teams.

Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j.

Experience with Azure Cosmos DB and Gremlin API.

Strong background in data engineering and data modelling.

Experience designing and developing Knowledge Graphs and ontologies.

Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration of data workflows into automated pipelines.

Understanding of graph querying, database architecture and data relationships.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with GraphRAG and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Experience integrating graph databases with LLM applications.

Knowledge of vector databases and hybrid search solutions.

Experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or security data analytics.

Experience with cloud-based data engineering solutions.

Experience working with Jira and agile methodologies.

jobs.occupation: Reliability Engineer / Asset Management Engineer, Addilon Professionals AB
jobs.description:
Drive Strategic Maintenance Excellence in Gothenburg
Join a large-scale industrial project as a Senior Reliability Engineer, where you will take both strategic and operational responsibility for asset structures and maintenance tactics. This hybrid contract role offers the opportunity to influence long-term reliability for critical infrastructure while collaborating with a global engineering team.
The Role and Your Impact
Reporting to the Asset Management Project Manager, you will act as the technical linchpin between our global project resources and the local Gothenburg site. Your focus will be on building a robust foundation for asset performance through structured data and proactive strategies.
Key Responsibilities
Establish and optimize technical asset hierarchies and Bill of Materials (BOM).
Define maintenance tactics utilizing RCM, FMEA, or PMO methodologies.
Ensure all maintenance strategies comply with ISO 55000 standards and local regulations.
Manage technical interfaces and present deliverables to diverse stakeholder groups.
Verify the accuracy of technical data within CMMS/EAM environments.

Professional Requirements
We are looking for a senior specialist with a B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical or Maintenance Engineering. You must have at least 5 years of experience in Reliability Engineering within large-scale industrial environments. Proficiency in English is mandatory for managing international stakeholders, alongside advanced skills in systems like SAP PM, IBM Maximo, or IFS. Deep knowledge of ISO 55000 is a prerequisite for success in this role.
Preferred Qualifications
Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) status.
Experience working with remote international teams.
Knowledge of Spare Parts Optimization and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) analysis.

What We Offer
Senior contract position in a high-profile industrial project.
Hybrid work arrangement based in Gothenburg.
Collaboration with an international team of 5 dedicated engineers.

Ready to optimize? Apply now to become our next Asset Management expert.

jobs.description:

This position offering the opportunity to combine welding engineering expertise, hands-on technical work and project management. IWE qualification is required
